# Omdan Development Inc
> Licensed residential contractor serving Palm Springs, the Coachella Valley, and the Inland Empire, CA.
> CSLB License #1148568 (Class B General Building Contractor)

## About
Omdan Development Inc is a licensed and insured residential contractor based in Palm Springs, California. It works on homes only, providing construction, remodeling, landscaping, and home improvement services for homeowners across the Coachella Valley, the high desert, and the Inland Empire, including Rancho Mirage. David leads the team and is personally involved in every project. Pricing is personalized after a free on-site estimate; the company does not publish prices.

## Services
- Paver Installation (concrete, brick, and travertine pavers for driveways, patios, walkways, and pool decks): https://omdandevelopment.com/pavers/
- Artificial Turf (lawns, pet/dog turf, playground turf, and putting greens): https://omdandevelopment.com/artificial-turf/
- Concrete (driveways, patios, walkways, and stamped concrete pool decks): https://omdandevelopment.com/concrete/
- Gravel, DG & Xeriscape (low-water desert landscaping with gravel and decomposed granite): https://omdandevelopment.com/gravel/
- Pool Remodeling & Resurfacing (replastering, pebble and quartz finishes, tile, coping, Cool Deck): https://omdandevelopment.com/pool-remodeling/
- Kitchen Remodeling (cabinets, countertops, backsplash, lighting, and full remodels): https://omdandevelopment.com/kitchen-remodeling/
- Bathroom Remodeling (showers, tubs, vanities, tile, and waterproofing): https://omdandevelopment.com/bathroom-remodeling/
- Window Replacement & Installation (retrofit and full-frame; vinyl, aluminum, fiberglass, and wood frames): https://omdandevelopment.com/windows/
- Roofing (residential roof work): https://omdandevelopment.com/roofing/
- Insulation (attic, spray foam, and blown-in insulation and air sealing): https://omdandevelopment.com/insulation/
- HVAC (residential heating and air conditioning): https://omdandevelopment.com/hvac/
- Cool Life Paint (heat-reflective exterior paint and coating): https://omdandevelopment.com/cool-life-paint/
- Exterior Painting (residential exterior painting): https://omdandevelopment.com/exterior-painting/
- Gutters (seamless gutter installation and repair): https://omdandevelopment.com/gutters/
- Plumbing (residential fixtures, leak repair, repipes, and water heaters): https://omdandevelopment.com/plumbing/
